traits.personality:
Independent and strong-willed, Sagittarius personalities are all about going off the beaten path. Sagittarius isn’t afraid to step away from the pack, and is a natural born leader who goes after what he or she wants, regardless of what other people think. Sagittarius is a born adventurer, and loves solo travel and exploration. Sagittarius also loves exploring the inner workings of their minds, and love stretching their horizons through a good book or movie.
Sagittarius is open-hearted, generous, and big-spirited, but Sagittarius is always truthful. Because of this, they may hurt others’ feelings, or may be called out for not having tact or empathy. The latter is not true. With their keen imagination, Sagittarius is adept at putting themselves in another person’s shoes—that’s why so many Sagittarius are successful actors—but they do not feel the need to beat around the bush or lie. You can trust a Sagittarius to tell you what they really think. You can also trust a Sagittarius, period. Unlike other signs, they won’t spill any secrets.
traits.friendship:
Sagittarius is a social butterfly, and loves meeting new people. This sign is always the first to RSVP to a party, and they love being the center of attention. Sagittarius is also very generous with their time and energy, and they will go out of their way to help a friend in need.
However, Sagittarius can also be a bit flaky. This sign loves to have fun, but they can also be easily distracted by new experiences. They may cancel plans at the last minute or forget to follow up with friends. But when a Sagittarius does commit to a friendship, they are loyal and supportive.
traits.love:
Sagittarius is a passionate lover, and they love to flirt. This sign is always up for a good time, and they love to keep things exciting in the bedroom. Sagittarius is also very open-minded, and they are willing to try new things when it comes to love.
However, Sagittarius can also be a bit commitment-phobic. This sign loves their freedom, and they may be hesitant to settle down with one person. They may also have trouble expressing their feelings, and they may come off as aloof or distant. But when a Sagittarius does fall in love, they are all in.
traits.lifestyle:
